story_overview: Distressed, Clara finds an ally in Jax. They head to The Corner Bakery, where workers Nico and Henri, along with Maya and Arthur, become embroiled in their urgent situation. The group later flees in a delivery van, their journey marked by tension and concern as they drive towards an unknown destination.
